study.question: Does broadening the latest target-field match anchor across behavior types supply useful temporal ordering beyond same-action ranks and anchor availability?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: r0015-raw_duplicate first512 frozen-checkpoint diagnostics have only0.15576171875 supported field/action coordinates, category_fav0.01171875, category_buy0.009765625, brand_buy0; these are a small contiguous sample, not population prevalence. Requiring the same action on receiving nonmatches and crossed-field match anchors discards possible cross-action chronology. A pooled latest match anchor in the other field, with receiving nonmatches still partitioned by action, may provide useful additional ordering. r0015 raw_duplicate AUC0.6200598769865169 exceeded raw_support0.619886252109345, so merely exposing extra availability has not established a benefit and duplication/optimization is a live alternative.

nearest_work.difference: Exact inherited parent; retain its original raw crossed same-action rank r and all preceding features. Replace only the existing auxiliary0.5r by0.5 pooled rank or support. No capacity increase.
same_presence function reproduces the old raw/support cell, although new pure selectors use raw_duplicate as parent and compute unused pooled summaries.

Prior all-anchor averaging was WITHIN an action and replaced the main rank; AUC0.6197123093757856 was below latest_rank0.6198327314720098 while Logloss improved0.19584283295051996 versus0.19590027201628102. Here take ONE latest anchor pooled ACROSS actions, retain the main rank, and use a matched auxiliary replacement. Distinct intervention; prior failure retained.

Inherit locally adapted activation idea and embeddings; primary DIN section4.3 abandons softmax normalization whereas this local parent retains normalized shared retrieval. New change is deterministic crossed-field cross-action order evidence, not an exact DIN reproduction or verified priority claim.

README confirms category/brand/action histories and absent item identity. Publisher paper is unavailable, a missing-source condition rather than counterevidence. No complete DMR mechanism comparison asserted.

inherited_components: Exact normalized blind-query aligned/shared field retrieval from the parent, category/brand/action/recency embeddings, MLP widths128/64
All supplied information, parent initialization draw order and zero-initialized appended columns
Target-matching counts and one-day decayed match counts, pair-valid support, latest match and latest nonmatch decay extrema
Original eight required-support crossed same-action latest-anchor midranks r; existing auxiliary width8
No new optimizer, training loss, labels, events, item identity, history length, or field tokens
study.proposed_difference: For receiving field f and action a, N_fa contains known-ID events unequal to its known target. Same anchor is minimum age among target matches in OTHER field with action a. Pooled anchor is minimum age among target matches in OTHER field over all four known actions. Support requires N_fa nonempty and chosen anchor present. Rank is mean over N_fa of1[age<anchor]+0.5*1[age=anchor], multiplied by support. Four cells replace only last8 existing auxiliary inputs with0.5rank or0.5support at same or pooled scope; original r is always retained. All summaries are computed in every cell without relying on event array order. Nearest authorized paper search for multi-behavior temporal order found no extra source; this bounded search does not establish novelty. No priority claim.
predictions: Pooled support contains same-action support, zero unknown targets and empty histories, with rank in[0,1]. On same-action support pooled rank cannot exceed same-action rank, because its latest anchor age is no larger. Host diagnostics must verify these identities.

If sparse anchor support is consequential, pooled_rank should improve full validation AUC over same_rank AND pooled_presence. Report pooled-minus-same AUC contrast for each value and their interaction, plus Logloss and costs regardless of outcome.

Descriptive diagnostics will report expansion and rank shifts for all8 field/action coordinates; no pretense that first512 support is a population estimate or those coordinates have sufficient positive labels.

same_rank and same_presence should reproduce the existing r0015 raw duplicate/support functions at seed42 apart from computation/kernel numerical differences, with identical parameter count and initialization. They are reproducibility controls, not new seeds.
falsifiers: Any future/non-prefix event, target ID0 equality, unsupported nonzero rank, subset violation or invalid/nonfinite logits invalidates the implementation, irrespective of AUC.

If pooled support does not expand or pooled rank is identical on all observed inputs, the proposed missing-comparison mechanism has no observed exposure in those inputs; sample512 cannot prove a population absence.

If pooled_rank does not beat same_rank and pooled_presence on full-population AUC, this implementation does not support added useful cross-action chronology. If only pooled_presence helps, availability or conditioning is the closer explanation.
A seed42 gain that disappears or reverses in paired seeds43/44 weakens the provisional performance claim. AUC/Logloss disagreement must be retained; do not pick metric after results.
alternative_explanations: Single seed and many adaptively inspected validation trajectories; no significance or repeated support
Presence replacements control availability but not all feature distributions or Adam conditioning; marginal scale and duplicated-gradient effects remain
Pooling takes the latest match across actions, mixing anchor semantics and changing recency on common support; it may mostly follow frequent pv
Candidate diagnostics cover first512 impressions only; frozen-checkpoint replacements are not retrained causal effects
History truncation and coarse category/brand identities limit interpretation; no item identity or psychological preference claim

Earlier trajectories reject simple mechanistic narratives: joint pair did not beat support pair; action-specific retrieval, adaptive queries, availability routing and aligned products did not beat their parents. None proves that richer interactions are universally ineffective.

Parameter redundancy, gradient scale and finite-horizon Adam conditioning can explain r0015 raw duplicate gains; support was not the winning information intervention. Factorial replaces that very auxiliary and reports the tradeoff.

Static snapshots lack documented as-of dates. Successful host baseline receipts establish an operational starting point, not verified production point-in-time validity.
